commit.message:
fix(ci): refresh the node lockfile after publishing the 0.5.1 natives (#127)

While the four honker-node-<platform> packages at 0.5.1 were unpublished,
npm recorded their lockfile entries with no version and no resolved URL.
That lockfile was valid. Publishing them made the entries resolvable, so
npm ci now rejects it:

  Invalid: lock file's @russellthehippo/honker-node-darwin-arm64@ does
  not satisfy @russellthehippo/honker-node-darwin-arm64@0.5.1

Nothing in the repo changed — the lockfile is stale only relative to a
registry that moved underneath it. Reproduced against the published
registry before and after regenerating, so this is the fix, not a
mechanical refresh.

Same failure as #118 after the 0.5.0 natives. bun.lock only pins
honker-ext at 0.4.6, which did not move, so it needs no refresh.
